adds.rationale: IonQ posted a genuine Q3 buildup-phase commercial inflection this quarter (111% YoY revenue growth, raised full-year bookings guidance, and an early technical milestone), giving the profile's #3-ranked next tech wave (quantum computing) its first concrete entry point.

news_evidence.summary: IonQ Q2 2023 revenue of $5.5M, up 111% YoY and above guidance; raised FY2023 revenue guidance to $18.9-19.3M and bookings guidance to $49-56M
IonQ hit its 2023 target of 29 algorithmic qubits (#AQ) seven months ahead of schedule, launched IonQ Forte, and opened a first European quantum data center with QuantumBasel
IonQ shares climbed 42% in July 2023 on new partnerships and a raised outlook

removes.rationale: NuScale's flagship CFPP project economics remain strained by January's 53% target-price hike to $89/MWh, and Q3 brought no offsetting subscription or customer win, leaving it the weakest thesis this quarter next to the AI, defense, rocket, and now quantum names that all posted fresh commercial catalysts.

news_evidence.summary: NuScale/UAMPS raised the CFPP target power price 53% to $89/MWh (from $58/MWh) on steel and construction cost inflation, straining project economics
NuScale's September 11, 2023 corporate/analyst-day update carried no new project subscriptions or customer announcements, with the CFPP subscription deadline still looming

rationale_overall: Core AI (MSFT, NVDA), defense (LMT), and rockets (RKLB) exposure all confirmed strong this quarter via fresh Q2 prints -- NVDA's data-center revenue up 171% YoY, LMT's record $158B backlog, MSFT nearing its Activision close, and RKLB's growing backlog -- so none of those four is disturbed. The one swap rotates nuclear (SMR), whose flagship project has carried an unresolved cost/subscription overhang since January with no Q3 catalyst, into quantum computing (IONQ), whose Q3 bookings and revenue growth are the strongest buildup-phase signal surfaced this cycle and fill the profile's #3-ranked next tech wave. Robotics (#2) was searched but surfaced no qualifying dated commercial milestone this quarter. Net watchlist stays at the 5-ticker cap: MSFT, NVDA, LMT, RKLB, IONQ.
